# Agora WUI

> Framework-agnostic React Teams UI for collaboration through an Agora Hub.

## Core Docs

- [README.md](README.md): overview, build, deployment boundary, and thread-card interaction model.
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): setup, embedding, browser authentication, and thread-card navigation.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): ownership and native-Hub topology.
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): exported React and client API.
- [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md): design and integration answers.
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): connection and rendering recovery.
